title: Farm Animals and Their Names Explained
reason: The video describes various farm animals and their care, showcasing diverse farm life.

tasks.task: Describe the different types of cows on a farm.

subtasks.text: Observe a Jersey steer and note that Jersey cows are known for producing rich milk.
Note that there are different breeds of cows, with some raised for meat and others for milk.

tasks.task: Explain the life cycle and terminology for piglets and their care.

subtasks.text: Observe a male pig and note that it is called a boar.
Describe how pigs seek shade and roll in mud to cool off.

tasks.task: Describe goats and their farm uses.

subtasks.text: Observe a male goat and note that it is called a billy goat.
Describe the production of goat milk and note that goat milk is good for making cheese.

tasks.task: Describe the care and farming of sheep.

subtasks.text: Observe a male sheep and note that it is called a ram.
Note that sheep are clipped for their wool to keep them cool in summer.

tasks.task: Describe farm animals in the context of horse care and riding.

subtasks.text: Observe horses grazing in a pasture and note their color.
Describe the care horses receive at a barn, including feeding and storage.
